pages.title: Writing to Files
pages.content: Use `"w"` mode to write to a file (overwrites existing content) or `"a"` mode to append to the end. Always use the `with` statement for safety.

pages.title: Write and Append
pages.content: Create or overwrite a file with `"w"`:
pages.code:
# Write (creates or overwrites)
with open("output.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("Hello!\n")
    file.write("Python is great.\n")

# Append (adds to end)
with open("output.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("This is a new line.\n")

pages.title: File Modes
pages.text: Use [blank] mode to write and [blank] mode to append to a file.
